name: whale-durable-idempotent-intent-delivery
instr:
Whale cannot durably track protocol intent delivery across its terminal runtime and JSON-lines app-server. Implement session-scoped, idempotent delivery while preserving untracked behavior.

Within a session, a nonempty DeliveryID identifies one immutable payload and terminal IntentReceipt. Identical concurrent or later deliveries share one reservation and outcome without repeating effects. Persist completed outcomes across reopening. Reused IDs with different payloads return ErrIntentDeliveryConflict from github.com/usewhale/whale/internal/store, valued "intent delivery payload conflict", without disturbing the original.

Settle known rejection, validation failure, dispatch refusal, tracked cancellation, and tracked shutdown as replayable receipts. This includes unsupported intent kinds. Leave interrupted unknown outcomes recoverable, without automatic redispatch or invented success. DeliveryReservation exposes Owner, Receipt, and Recoverable. DeliveryRecovery exposes DeliveryID, Receipt, and Recoverable.

Use IntentReceiptStatus and IntentReceipt from github.com/usewhale/whale/internal/runtime/protocol consistently across Intent.DeliveryID, ClientMessage.DeliveryID, and ServerMessage.Receipt. Export Service.DispatchProtocolTracked and service.New from github.com/usewhale/whale/internal/app/service, plus Runtime.DispatchTracked and tuiadapter.NewRuntime from github.com/usewhale/whale/internal/ui/tuiadapter.

Both clients retry uncertain deliveries against persisted settlemen
